milestones.title: Foundation: Technique, tuning, metronome, and basic loop
milestones.capability_statement: Establish clean left- and right-hand technique, verify tuning, and operate the loop pedal to record a basic tempo-aligned loop.
milestones.why_it_matters: A solid foundation ensures clean tone, precise timing, and safe looping before introducing pentatonic content.
milestones.demonstration_gate: Demonstrate clean fretting on a simple exercise, verify tuning with tuner, and record a 4-bar loop in tempo with metronome.
pass_criteria: No buzzing or muted notes on a 4-bar exercise
Guitar stays in tune within ±2 cents for the loop duration
Loop records and plays back a 4-bar loop without noise
Metronome tempo is maintained during the loop
Ergonomics are comfortable without strain
failure_routes: Revisit basic technique at slower tempo; adjust hand position; retune as needed
Practice tuner usage and ensure consistent strap height
Record shorter loops and gradually extend

milestones.title: Pentatonic mapping and two-position fluency
milestones.capability_statement: Identify and map pentatonic patterns across the neck and play two adjacent positions with clean fingering and smooth transitions.
milestones.why_it_matters: Two-position fluency enables flexible improvisation and navigation for looping blues.
milestones.demonstration_gate: Demonstrate connected pentatonic patterns across two positions with consistent tone and tempo on metronome.
pass_criteria: Accurate fingerings for both positions with minimal string noise
Seamless transitions without losing tonal center
Tone remains clean across both positions
Tempo maintained with metronome
failure_routes: Break down transitions into smaller steps; practice each position separately; slower tempo

milestones.title: Loop rhythm and first lead over loop
milestones.capability_statement: Record a rhythm loop and add an initial melodic pentatonic phrase over it, staying in key at a moderate tempo.
milestones.why_it_matters: Integrates looping with melodic content to begin real improvisation within loop context.
milestones.demonstration_gate: Record a 4-bar rhythm loop and an 8-bar pentatonic phrase over it, in time with the metronome and with stable tuning.
pass_criteria: Rhythm loop plays cleanly for at least 4 bars
Melodic pentatonic phrase uses patterns across positions with correct fingering
Phrase stays in key and in time with loop
Tuning remains stable during phrase
failure_routes: Divide into separate rhythm and melody practice; slow tempo; ensure loop start alignment
Retune if pitch drifts; adjust dynamics

milestones.title: Overdub and layering: rhythm + lead
milestones.capability_statement: Add a second lead layer over the loop, balance levels, and apply tone control for clean multi-layer sound.
milestones.why_it_matters: Layering is essential for a complete looping blues context and helps manage mix clarity.
milestones.demonstration_gate: Produce a two-layer loop with rhythm and lead overdub in sync, exhibiting controlled levels and clear articulation.
pass_criteria: Overdub recorded in time with rhythm loop
Two layers are audible with clear separation
Lead stays within pentatonic shapes and key
Tone remains clean with minimal noise
failure_routes: Mute and re-balance levels; re-record overdub
Practice muting and timing separately; slow tempo

milestones.title: Blues improvisation over loop (8–12 bars)
milestones.capability_statement: Improvise an 8–12 bar blues melody using pentatonic shapes over the loop, applying voice-leading and staying in key.
milestones.why_it_matters: Achieves creative fluency and blues phrasing within looping context.
milestones.demonstration_gate: Perform an 8–12 bar blues solo over the loop with coherent phrasing and voice-leading.
pass_criteria: Groove maintained throughout
Improvised line uses pentatonic shapes and voice-leading
Key and backing harmony are coherent
failure_routes: Back to pentatonic phrasing practice; slow tempo; analyze phrasing

milestones.title: Complete loop flow: rhythm + lead chain
milestones.capability_statement: Execute the full looping sequence: record rhythm, overdub lead, playback, and perform reflective analysis on your loop performance.
milestones.why_it_matters: Culminates the track by integrating all prior skills into a cohesive performable flow.
milestones.demonstration_gate: Complete loop chain with rhythmic and lead layers, playback, and self-review of performance.
pass_criteria: All layers in groove with synchronized playback
Dynamic shaping and phrasing evident in performance
Safety and ergonomics maintained; feedback solicited
failure_routes: Revisit loop flow order; adjust levels; re-record

design_rationale: The milestones progress from foundational technique, tuning, and timing to pentatonic pattern mapping and two-position fluency, ensuring reliable fretboard navigation before introducing looping content.
Looping capabilities are introduced early enough to build confidence with rhythm and timing (milestones 1–2), then progressively integrated with rhythm recording and overdubbing (milestones 3–4).
Milestone 3 bridges technique and loop practice by pairing a rhythm track with a melodic phrase, setting the stage for layering and dynamic control in milestone 4.
Mid-track milestones emphasize safe, clean layering and tone management to create a clear, legible loop texture suitable for blues improvisation.
Milestone 5 centers blues improvisation within the looping context, leveraging voice-leading and key/stability to develop musical phrasing.
The final milestone synthesizes rhythm, lead, safety, and reflective practice into a complete loop performance, highlighting performance readiness and self-analysis for continual growth.
